name: hesocial-platform
description: High-end social event platform for affluent individuals

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:web-rust
scripts.build:worker: cd backend-rust && cargo build -p hesocial-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.lint:rust: cd backend-rust && cargo clippy --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: echo 'typecheck: frontend archived, Rust checked via clippy'
scripts.setup: npm install && cd contract && npm install
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:docs && npm run lint && npm run test

author: HeSocial Platform Team
